main.description: The only mutable write in ADR-0039. Move a ref's points-to from expectedCurrent to newCommit. CAS-safe by default; force=true skips ancestry check. Emits OCEL event ref:updated / ref:rolledBack / ref:forcePushed and a firehose com.etzhayyim.repository.refUpdate record.

expectedCurrent.description: Current head commit hash the caller expects. Server rejects with RefOutOfDate if mismatch. Omit only with force=true.

force.description: If true, skip fast-forward/ancestry check. Generates OCEL event ref:forcePushed.

reason.description: Human-readable reason. Required when force=true or when newCommit is an ancestor of current (= rollback). Logged to OCEL event payload.

updateKind.description: fastForward = new is descendant of previous; rolledBack = new is ancestor; forcePushed = neither (requires force=true).

firehoseCid.description: CID of the com.etzhayyim.repository.refUpdate record written to the owner DID's AT Repo.

errors.name: RefOutOfDate
errors.description: expectedCurrent does not match server state.

errors.name: ForceRequired
errors.description: newCommit is not a descendant of previousCommit; caller must set force=true with a reason.
